plugins.description: Guides a BA through turning raw communication into structured requirement documentation: project initiation, intake, signal extraction, use-case and business-rule drafting behind a written review gate, a per-feature check that the resulting use cases actually add up, approval, entity sync, a verified UX design spec plus an on-request prototype render, and a business-flow PRD per feature.
